Kerala Ministers Attend Leadership Retreat at IIM Kozhikode

Ministers from the Kerala cabinet participated in a two-day strategic leadership retreat at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) in Kozhikode. The event, titled 'Reimagining Keralam', focused on leadership development and strategic planning for the state. The retreat took place over two days at the IIM Kozhikode campus.
